_about: The 19 regional characters of Saudi architecture as drawn on the About and 404 pages. Read from ARCY-Official worker/agent/regulations/saudi-guidelines/ (params/*.json and dna/*.json, commit 15c611c), which extract the Architecture and Design Commission's published guidelines (architsaudi.dasc.gov.sa). Each value is taken inside the published range and cites its page ('G' guidelines, 'V' villa handbook, 'L' low-rise handbook, 'p' the parameter file's page). 'omit' lists what the data does not describe well enough to draw, so it is left out rather than invented. Band spacing marked illustrative is not given by the data. cite_ar and omit_ar are the same lines in Arabic, figures and page codes kept exactly. Page codes: G = the design guidelines, V = the villa handbook, L = the low-rise handbook, p = the page given in the parameter file.
source: Architecture and Design Commission (DASC), Saudi architecture design guidelines, via ARCY-Official saudi-guidelines dataset
